page: Amazon Web Services r8gb.metal-48xl is a bare-metal memory-optimized instance powered by eighth-generation 64-bit ARM AWS Graviton processors. It features 192 dedicated physical cores running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz, operating with a single thread per core without simultaneous multithreading. As a bare-metal deployment, execution occurs directly on hardware without virtualization layers or hypervisor overhead.

The platform integrates 1536.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core. The system contains no integrated local storage, requiring persistent disk storage to be attached remotely over the network. Network connectivity is supported by an interconnect delivering a baseline network bandwidth of 400 Gbps. The server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and does not provide hardware GPU acceleration.

The 1:8 core-to-memory density combined with dedicated execution eliminates core sharing and noisy neighbor contention. Due to the ARM64 architecture, bare-metal access, high-bandwidth network fabric, and expansive RAM capacity, the r8gb.metal-48xl is structured for scale-out in-memory databases, key-value stores, distributed analytics pipelines, and memory-intensive enterprise software.
